title: catch-up 4: the follower asks, applies, and reports an unfillable gap
description:
docs/design/mimi-catchup.md §10, follower side.

Persist the highest sequence held per room. Notice a gap two ways: a sequence jump in live fanout, and at startup after downtime. Then ask the hub (discovering catchUp from its directory, and doing nothing if the hub does not publish it), apply in hub order, and stop once caught up.

When the hub says the gap cannot be filled (§5.1), record it against the room and surface it, so the agent and its front ends can tell the user rather than showing a conversation with a silent hole. mimid already has the shape internally: the store's feed answers TooOld and the front ends redraw instead of pretending (MIMI_EV_RESYNC in purple-mimi). The same honesty is owed across providers, and this is the whole point of the work: silent loss is what is being removed.

Tests: a follower that missed a range catches up and its users see the messages; a jump in live fanout triggers a catch-up; an out-of-window gap is recorded and surfaced, not swallowed; a hub without the template is left alone.
